subject: grad
title: GRAD.------DOC.
description: Diagram in WI-11, the section where Braxton introduces the *gradualism* concept by way of the talk-show anecdote about a white jazz musician who named Tony Bennett the best jazz singer in history, Woody Herman's the best big band, etc. — illustrating how 'the perpetuation of a given viewpoint, in a given time parameter, can be solidified as true, if not successfully challenged.' (C)GRAD (gradualism) is crossed with DOC (documentation): the diagram poses what gradualism actually does to documentation. GRAD → DOC (the crossing), and GRAD → CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). CULT-INFO-F branches to DEF (definition) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). DEF → INFO-INTR (information interpretation) → INT (intention) → POL-SIGN (political significance). PHY-U-P → TRS (transition) → RT-DY (reality dynamics) → PART (participation).
